bindingStructure: key-scoped is a subset of kind-wide for the same system burden, so the key-scoped reduction is never larger: its numeric bar binds. Kind-wide carries the equal-recall comparison (the ccg-noise-recall-rule-v1 flag), which key-scoped can fail to meet. Each variant is computed with ccg-noise-recall-rule-v1 unchanged.
decides: S1: which noise-reduction baseline variant carries the AC-5 reduction bar of -p1-ml.md 5.3 (at least 5x) at the next gate (ac5-gate-1 over the gated strata)
disclosures: this record states what was observed in the repository at its writing; it does not claim the rehearsal scratch logs were clean (see priorPrints.notCovered)
a rule changed after scoring counts as after adaptation and is reported as such

laterUnitsPrintOnly.mechanism: the printing is a dispatch-brief rule, enforced by reading the run output before it is quoted; baseline.py and noise.py are not changed for it (their hashes are pinned below)
laterUnitsPrintOnly.rule: Until the ac5-gate-1 pre-registration record is committed (CO-6b), every dispatch of CO-1..CO-5 and the CO-9 rehearsal prints only aggregate noise: Q (the AC-5 noise statistic as the harness defines it) and the wrong-`possible` bound. It prints no kind-wide reduction, no key-scoped reduction, no per-variant burden sum and no baseline [k, n]. A run that prints one is reported in the ac5-gate-1 record with its date and the figure, and the reduction bar is not weakened by it.

rule: The reduction bar of `-p1-ml.md` §5.3 (at least 5x) is met iff both the kind-wide and the key-scoped in-scope reductions are at least 5x, each computed with the rule of `ccg-noise-recall-rule-v1`; the all-listed reductions are reported beside; the recall flag is reported per variant and a flagged variant is an upper bound, not a pass. Neither variant's held-out reduction has been seen; any dev reduction seen before this record is listed with its date.
